_note: Exide reports one Ind AS 108 segment (storage batteries and allied products; automotive and industrial aggregated, AR FY26 note on segments). The model is built on the STANDALONE company (the lead-acid business, which is how the street values the core). 'core' = standalone revenue and EBITDA (Screener standalone basis). The lithium-ion subsidiary (Exide Energy Solutions, EESL) sits outside the standalone accounts: 'groupDrag' = consolidated net profit less standalone net profit (EESL and Chloride Metals losses, consolidation entries). Business-line sizes for FY26 are management's ballpark figures (calls of 6-May-2026 and 3-Aug-2026), not reported segments.

annual.note: FY22 standalone PAT includes the Rs4,694 cr pre-tax exceptional gain on the Exide Life sale (AR FY26 10-year table); consolidated basis differs (life business consolidated until sale).

annual.linesSrc: Exports Rs915 cr = sales outside India (AR FY26 note 25); home UPS 'more than Rs2,000 cr, around Rs2,300 cr' and auto ~50-53% of revenue (Q4FY26 call); solar 'crossed Rs1,000 cr' (AR FY26); industrial domestic (infrastructure, traction, railways, telecom, submarine, other) is the remainder. GAM split, rounded.
